A component's props, with the server answering lazyLoad

Source: R/el_load_children.R
dot-el_lazy_props.Rd

el-cascader and el-cascader-panel take their loader inside props, so a computed property adds one that asks the server – unless the user gave their own, or the cascader is not lazy.

Usage

.el_lazy_props(ns_id)

Arguments

ns_id

The component's id.

Value

A JS function, the computed property.
